title: Apple's brutal sales warning sparked a Wall Street debate on whether tech stocks will be dragged into a disastrous downturn (AAPL)
text: Apple's brutal sales warning sparked a Wall Street debate on whether tech stocks will be dragged into a disastrous downturn (AAPL) By Jake Kanter and Becky Peterson Jan 3, 2019, 1:56 pm 13 pts Apple sent shockwaves through global markets on Wednesday with its first earnings warning in 16 years. The firm had a shopping list of issues to pin blame on, but Wall Street bankers and analysts told Business Insider that some problems are of its own making. The company is more exposed to troubles…
